Home / Solicitations / SOL-2026-044

Grounds keeping, north promenade district

SOL-2026-044 · Request for proposals · Parks and Public Spaces

Summary

Closing dateSep 4, 2026, 2 p.m. Central
Issuing departmentParks and Public Spaces
ContactMarisol Etchell, buyer, bids@lakefront-vn.example
ResponsesRegistered partners only, through the partner console

Scope of work

Mowing, edging, litter collection and seasonal bed planting across 11 acres of the north promenade, the band shell lawn and the lakefront steps, with a weekly visit from April through October and a monthly visit through the winter.

  • Three-year term.
  • Proposals are scored 60% on price and 40% on method statement and references.
  • Mowers must meet the city's low-noise ordinance before 8 a.m.

Addenda

No addenda have been issued.

Questions about this solicitation go to the contact above in writing, no later than seven days before the closing date. Answers are published here as addenda.
